templates.title: Yuvomi
templates.name: yuvomi
templates.description: Yuvomi is a self-hosted family planner for tasks, calendar, meals, shopping, budget, and documents. It stores data in one SQLite database on your server.

env.name: PORT
env.label: PORT
env.description: Port the app listens on inside the container.

env.name: DB_PATH
env.label: DB_PATH
env.description: SQLite database path inside the data volume.

env.name: SESSION_SECRET
env.label: SESSION_SECRET
env.description: Session signing secret. Yuvomi 2.73.0 refuses to start while this starts with REPLACE_WITH_. Replace it in the install form before the first start. Changing it later signs everyone out.

env.name: DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.label: DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: AES-256 key for the database at rest. A lost or changed key cannot open an existing database.

env.name: SESSION_SECURE
env.label: SESSION_SECURE
env.description: Set true only behind HTTPS. Direct HTTP login needs false.

env.name: TRUST_PROXY
env.label: TRUST_PROXY
env.description: Proxy trust for direct HTTP. Use 1 behind a single reverse proxy.

env.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_LOCAL_ENABLED
env.label: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_LOCAL_ENABLED
env.description: Store uploaded documents on the documents volume when true.

env.name: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH
env.label: DOCUMENT_STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH
env.description: In-container path for local document storage.
